seoTitle: How to Make a Container Full Width in Elementor
metaDescription: Fix an Elementor container that stays boxed by adjusting content width settings, removing padding and margin, and clearing theme restrictions.
intro: A container that refuses to stretch full width despite the correct settings is a common Elementor frustration, usually caused by theme conflicts or leftover padding. This guide walks through the settings that actually control full width behavior and how to fix a boxed layout for good.

steps.heading: Set the container to full width
steps.body: In the container's layout settings, change the content width option from boxed to full width so it stretches across the screen.

steps.heading: Remove padding and margin restrictions
steps.body: Check the container's advanced spacing settings for leftover padding or margin values that could be preventing it from reaching the true edge of the screen.

steps.heading: Fix boxed layout caused by theme settings
steps.body: Some WordPress themes apply their own content width restrictions outside of Elementor, so check your theme's layout settings if the container still looks boxed.

steps.heading: Test on desktop and mobile
steps.body: Full width settings can behave differently across breakpoints, so review the container on both desktop and mobile views to confirm it stretches properly everywhere.

faq.question: Why is my Elementor container still boxed after setting it to full width?
faq.answer: This is often caused by a theme applying its own content width restriction outside of Elementor's control, or leftover padding/margin on the container.

faq.question: Does full width work differently on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, full width settings can be overridden by responsive breakpoints, so it's worth checking the container's appearance separately on mobile.

faq.question: Is this feature available in Elementor's free version?
faq.answer: Yes, container width settings are part of Elementor's core functionality and available on the free plan.

faq.question: Can page builder conflicts cause this issue?
faq.answer: Yes, conflicting CSS from other plugins or the active theme can override Elementor's full width setting, so it's worth checking for conflicts if the fix doesn't work.
